paper: MetaPS: Adaptive Programmatic Strategy Selection for Market Agents
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock analogue of MetaPS-9B V3 that learns a chronological router over ten explicit strategy programs from counterfactual rollout labels; not the missing Qwen checkpoint, SFT records, teacher traces, market simulator, or native action path.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: MetaPS ranks executable strategy programs, rolls each forward in a simulator, converts state-strategy outcomes into V1/V2/V3 supervision, trains a router, and delegates inference actions to the selected program.
V3 balances short-horizon winners and medium-horizon competence; MetaPS-9B V3 is the reported headline stock router and keeps multiple strategy behaviors available.
V1 selects the local rollout winner, V2 blends multi-horizon utility and candidate edge, and V3 chooses a good label while penalizing overrepresented strategies.
Ten named programmatic stock strategies emit an action, confidence, and coarse exposure bucket before runtime feasibility checks.

macro_rotation.monthly_rule: risk-on momentum/beta or risk-off value/low-beta rotation

earnings_drift.monthly_rule: fundamental surprise with short drift confirmation

small_cap_breakout.monthly_rule: small-cap momentum near the trailing high

volatility_breakout.monthly_rule: one-month direction weighted by low volatility compression

supervision_policy.router_model: rolling standardized one-vs-rest ridge least-squares classifier
supervision_policy.update_schedule: monthly expanding observation with a fixed trailing 120-label training window
supervision_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: the selected program score multiplied by its coarse exposure fraction enters fixed value-weighted long-short deciles and all six common paths

preserved_elements: router trained on state and strategy context
selected program delegates the final score
approximated_elements: JKP price, accounting-surprise, risk, value, quality, and liquidity fields replace daily price, news, and order flow
ten deterministic cross-sectional scores replace the unreleased Python strategy modules and helpers
common monthly backtests replace simulator rollouts
deterministic V3 quality/frequency formulas replace underspecified label constants
rolling ridge classification replaces Qwen3.5 supervised fine-tuning and teacher-rewritten rationales
common deciles replace single-ticker actions and inventory-aware execution
low-volatility directional weighting repairs the literal unreachable volatility-breakout listing
invented_elements: the exact JKP formulas for all ten strategies
the V3 quality, active-bonus, and frequency-penalty constants
